text: util::domains ports classify_direct, the classifier behind the May 2026 MGnify multi-domain analysis in ~/00-nail-benchmarks/05-19-multi-domain-hmmer/. A differential test ran classify against the original on 5 million generated cases and agreed; it was scratch under tmp-claude and was removed on 6 Oct 2026. data/mgy-cutoffs.tbl has no hmmer column, and the cutoffs.txt that analysis read is gone.
